status: REAL RESULT — rank #1 by E-distance. Interpreted as a POSITIVE CONTROL (TCR-essential accelerator), NOT a therapeutic KO nominee.
modality_context: KO (Shifrut/Marson primary human CD8 T-cell CRISPR-KO); concordance rule: concordant = protective_lof

real_result.interpretation: Largest causal transcriptional footprint in the screen — exactly as expected for ablating a core TCR-CD3 subunit. Validates that the power-equalized E-distance recovers the strongest bona fide perturbation unsupervised.

ensembl_expected: ENSG00000167286 (literature; unverified — OT unavailable this run to confirm)

identifiers.chembl_target_note: ChEMBL target is the CD3 PROTEIN COMPLEX (subunits CD3E/P07766, CD3G/P09693, CD3D/P04234); no CD3D-delta-only ChEMBL target record.

io_rationale: CD3 delta chain of the TCR-CD3 complex; required for TCR surface assembly and proximal signaling. KO collapses TCR signaling, producing the largest state shift in the panel. Loss-of-function IMPAIRS effector function (it is the accelerator, not a brake) — so despite the top effect size it is a control, not an enhancement target.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL complex CHEMBL2364168 with 30+ PDB structures and 16 drug mechanisms (max_phase 4). BUT approved agents are CD3 T-cell engagers / cross-linkers that AGONIZE / redirect the TCR — orthogonal-to-opposite of the loss-of-function-to-enhance-persistence hypothesis a KO hit implies.

genetic_evidence.anchor_disease: T-B+ SCID (immunodeficiency 19, biallelic LoF) — Mendelian, not common-variant GWAS
genetic_evidence.rationale: Rare biallelic CD3D LoF causes severe combined immunodeficiency: loss ablates immunity. This is the signature of an IMMUNE ACCELERATOR, the opposite of a protective_lof brake — not concordant under the KO rule and not a disease-risk GWAS direction. Excluded from the common-variant directional funnel (any_gwas=false).

known_drugs.note: All engage/redirect T cells via the CD3 complex — a validated APPROVED target class, but the modality is agonistic/redirective, NOT knockdown-to-enhance.

active_trials.query: intervention = CD3 bispecific OR T-cell engager OR blinatumomab; status RECRUITING/ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING
active_trials.note: Large active CD3-engager landscape confirms the class is clinically validated — but as a T-cell-redirection modality, not as a persistence-enhancing KO.

essentiality.note: Immune-restricted but FUNCTIONALLY essential for TCR signaling in T cells; KO is a loss of the core effector machinery.

safety_flags: KO abolishes T-cell antigen recognition (immunodeficiency phenotype). Not a viable enhancement-KO target; role here is method validation / positive control.
